name: João Oliveira
title: Software Engineer
tagline: Backend engineer at Teya. MSc in Informatics and Computing Engineering from the University of Porto.

current.summary: Building the infrastructure behind Teya's supply chain.

about: I am passionate about creating things that matter.

At INESC TEC, I spent a year and a half building personalised mental health support, working closely with therapists and the real patients it was meant to help. It taught me that the most rewarding engineering sits close to real people.

Today I am at Teya, building the systems that get terminals into merchants' hands. Behind every order is someone opening a café, a salon or a small shop, and a mistake on our side can leave them unable to serve their first customer.

points: Part of the Supply Chain team, building Teya's **order management** and **asset management** systems, the source of truth for every payment terminal across its lifecycle, from the warehouse to the merchant. Together they serve **hundreds of thousands of requests a day**.
Working with warehouse and field-service partners so every order and every device stays in sync, wherever it is.
Helping our services handle failure gracefully, so they can recover when something goes wrong.
Integrating **Federated Learning** with Reinforcement Learning for secure, decentralised AI model training that protects sensitive healthcare data.
Developed adaptive **Reinforcement Learning** models that tailor digital micro-interventions to individual needs and behaviours.
Researched how to train and deploy machine learning models across decentralised healthcare data while keeping privacy, efficiency and scalability.
